tools.name: calculate_gst
tools.description:
Add GST to a GST-exclusive amount, or extract the GST contained in a GST-inclusive amount. Computed in integer cents so results never drift by rounding.

Note that GST within an inclusive price is one ELEVENTH, not one tenth — getting that backwards understates the tax on every inclusive-priced line

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: screen_against_sanctions, capture_web_page_with_proof, verify_web_page_attestation, check_ai_crawler_access, triage_ai_crawler_access, watch_ai_crawler_access, verify_ai_crawler, verify_email_address · Private data: capture_web_page_with_proof, verify_web_page_attestation, normalise_entity_name, check_ai_crawler_access, triage_ai_crawler_access, watch_ai_crawler_access, verify_ai_crawler, verify_email_address · Public sink: verify_ai_crawler, verify_email_address · Destructive: validate_australian_identifier, verify_web_page_attestation.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: screen_against_sanctions, capture_web_page_with_proof, verify_web_page_attestation, check_ai_crawler_access, triage_ai_crawler_access, watch_ai_crawler_access, verify_ai_crawler, verify_email_address · Private data: capture_web_page_with_proof, verify_web_page_attestation, normalise_entity_name, check_ai_crawler_access, triage_ai_crawler_access, watch_ai_crawler_access, verify_ai_crawler, verify_email_address · Public sink: verify_ai_crawler, verify_email_address · Destructive: validate_australian_identifier, verify_web_page_attestation

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
